name: Phenyl acetate
description: Phenyl acetate (CAS 122-79-2 ), also known as phenol acetate, is an aromatic ester used as a flavoring and fragrance ingredient across food and personal care markets. With FEMA number 3958 , it delivers a characteristic honey-like, floral scent profile. This chemical positions itself as a functional building block for flavor and fragrance houses globally. In food and beverage formulations, it contributes honey, rose, and floral nuances to confectionery, baked goods, and beverages at low use levels. Fragrance compounders incorporate it into fine fragrance, soap, and cosmetic bases where a soft, sweet floral character is required. Personal care manufacturers use it in shampoos, lotions, and body care products to support scent profiles. The compound features a natural-adjacent character that is highly valued in modern formulations. It also functions as an intermediate in the synthesis of more complex aroma chemicals for industrial fragrance production. The material is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid for various industrial applications. It is available in fragrance-grade and flavor-grade specifications to meet specific regulatory requirements for different end-use markets. The flavor-grade material conforms to relevant food-additive standards to ensure safety and compliance. Packaging typically ranges from small drums to bulk quantities suited to fragrance and flavor manufacturing operations. This versatile ester remains a staple for chemists looking to achieve specific floral notes.
